svg.title: P018 · Customers with no order in the last 90 days
svg.desc: One row per customer without an order in the 90-date window. The latest order is March 31. January 1 through March 31 inclusive covers ninety dates. Asha matches order 10. Ben's order is too old and Cia has no order. All three customers remain, with two empty right sides. Asha leaves because her match has ID 10. Ben and Cia both have a NULL matched order ID. Ben (ID 2) signed up before Cia (ID 3). Both qualify even though their order histories differ. Prepare the dates · FROM Orders. The date window depends on the most recent transaction. The CTE returns one pair of dates for the whole report. Outer query first · FROM Customers. Every customer is a candidate for outreach, including Cia, who has never ordered. Only the customer list contains everyone to test. Second · LEFT JOIN Orders. Match the two CustomerID columns and test the order date in ON. The left join keeps Ben and Cia with NULL order IDs when neither has a qualifying order.
